title: Discussion: vintage stability versus continued modern declines
content: A collector argues that vintage and mid-era graded prices may be stabilizing while modern supply remains elevated. Replies distinguish graded prices from raw-card behavior and challenge the broader market narrative. This is opinion, not verified transaction data.

title: Discussion: scarcity, population and the middle ground
content: A collector worries that vintage prices have risen too quickly while modern cards have high graded populations. Replies suggest considering older modern sets, but offer conflicting expectations. No sale prices or population counts have been independently validated.
